versions.title: Admin Branding & Update Access
versions.summary: Corrected Settings access for Admin and Master Admin.
changes: Master Admin and Admin can access Version & Updates.
Master Admin and Admin can access eligible Application Branding.
Backend license checks remain active for protected licensed features.
Supervisor, Technician, and Viewer remain restricted from update and branding administration.

versions.title: Unified Pro Branding
versions.summary: Unified company branding across AMT web and generated PDFs.
changes: Added company-logo branding for the application shell and sign-in experience.
Unified company branding across Maintenance PDFs and exported PDFs.
Added Reset to AMT Logo while retaining the built-in AMT logo permanently.
Standardized PDF credit to: Powered by AMT (Asset Maintenance Tracker) - LogiSource Digital.
Introduced the Admin update-access foundation completed in 1.1.5.

versions.title: Updater Reliability & Release Integrity
versions.summary: Improved signed updater reliability and release consistency.
changes: Fixed stale updater status reporting during new installations.
Corrected release exclusion handling so tracked environment example files are preserved.
Improved release-builder Git and SSH user handling.
Hardened updater deployment ownership, permissions, and runtime-version behavior.

versions.title: Secure Self-Update Stabilization
versions.summary: Stabilized signed self-update installation and rollback behavior.
changes: Added reliable runtime-version tracking separate from the source fallback VERSION file.
Preserved production frontend environment configuration during updates.
Improved source ownership, permissions, backup behavior, and rollback safety.
Continued SHA256 and public-key signature verification before installation.

versions.title: Feature Rollup & Secure Update Foundation
versions.summary: Major AMT feature rollup and initial secure update foundation.
changes: Consolidated QR Equipment Passport, maintenance-document organization, calibration tracking, role/menu controls, licensing, and secure update foundations.
The 1.1.1 package was revoked after deployment validation exposed updater/runtime-preservation issues.
Functional improvements were carried forward into corrected later releases.
Existing installations should not use 1.1.1.

versions.title: Initial Production Release
changes: Equipment registry and equipment history.
Maintenance lifecycle and reporting.
Inventory, spare parts, and materials tracking.
Client, job, assignment, and location workflows.
Reports, audit history, role-based access, MongoDB data, and private document storage.
